# Topology keys: where TLS really terminates. lib/inventory.js and cli/ssl_origin_scan.py read this
# file, and the CSV, YAML and JSON next to it, to the same servers (expected.json); a key neither
# knows (owner=) is ignored. Lines 11-15 and 19 are TOPOLOGY warnings.
lb01 203.0.113.2 ports=443,8443 vip=203.0.113.50 backends=web01,web02 owner=ops
lb02 203.0.113.3 vip=203.0.113.50 backends="web01, web02"
web01 10.0.0.21 terminates_tls=no
web02 10.0.0.22 Terminates-TLS=yes ports=8443
10.0.0.30 app01 nat=203.0.113.10
db01 10.0.0.40:5432 ports=443
# malformed values, a second terminates_tls and a key without a server: warnings, never dropped
bad01 10.0.0.50 ports=0,https
bad02 10.0.0.51 terminates_tls=maybe vip=203.0.113.300
bad03 10.0.0.52 nat=203.0.113.60:443 backends=web99,bad03
web01 10.0.0.21 terminates_tls=yes
ports=443
[web]
web03 ansible_host=10.0.0.70 terminates_tls=no
[web:vars]
ports=8443
